mentions.name: FTC NiMH Battery Tester PCB
mentions.description: This custom PCB reads the voltage and internal resistance of the 12V NiMH batteries used by FIRST Tech Challenge robots, showing battery charge and health via a WS2812B RGB LED instead of a screen. It is small, easy to assemble, runs on an ATTiny412, and uses Arduino firmware.
mentions.problem: It's not always easy to know how charged or healthy a NiMH battery is for a match, or when it's time to get rid of it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I designed custom PCBs which read the voltage and internal resistance of the 12V NiMH batteries used by robots in FIRST Tech Challenge.
